body.statement:
Under \(p_n/n\to\kappa\in(0,1)\) and independent standard Gaussian rows,
\[
 \frac{\lambda_{\max}(Q_n^\top Q_n)}n
 \longrightarrow_{\mathbb P}(1+\sqrt\kappa)^2.
\]

source.locator: Abstract and upper-edge by-product, specialized to identity covariance and Gaussian entries
source.verbatim_statement: Also, as a by-product, it is shown that the almost sure limit of the largest eigenvalue is (1+sqrt(y))^2.

attestation.note: Directly checked the Project Euclid source page for Bai and Yin (1993), doi:10.1214/aop/1176989118; Gaussian identity covariance specializes its iid finite-fourth-moment result.
